reasoning: The finding's evidence names two vendors: OpenAIProvider L94 and 'AnthropicProvider.loadCredentials L82-90 has the same shape'. The diff fixes only OpenAI: OpenAIProvider.swift:105-112 re-reads inside the flight and skips the exchange if the token was already rotated. The Anthropic sibling at AnthropicProvider.swift:99-110 still exchanges `credentials.refreshToken`, which the caller captured before the await. It has no re-read, so a late caller that arrives after an earlier flight cleared the slot still spends an already-rotated token. It is the same refreshAndWriteBack function mirrored across the two vendors. The report has one test for this id, and it covers OpenAI only.
